messages:
clare: heads-up: saw a small set of SSE clients get the last chunk duplicated after the routing-policy rollout at 08:17 UTC. some tenants reported double charges.
sam: can you paste a short sanitized trace?
clare: minimal repro (sanitized):
```
2026-07-09T08:17:11Z session=s-77 conn=sse-9 prox=edge-eu-3 action=route_reassign old_owner=edge-eu-3 new_owner=edge-eu-5 close=forced
2026-07-09T08:17:11Z session=s-77 reconnect=1 resume_token=rt:9xy seq=412 billing_check=miss
2026-07-09T08:17:11Z session=s-77 client_reports=dup_fragment_ms=150
```
clare: dup_fragment_ms ~150ms (small tail) and billing_check=miss when route flips.
jordan: likely cause: new routing path accepts resume before tombstone/dedupe metadata is replicated. our dedupe key includes route_id so flip breaks it.
sam: short-term hotfix: add 2s server-side dedupe window for resumes immediately following a route_reassign/eviction event. cheap and reversible.
jordan: medium-term: two options: 1) include a signed prev_route_hint in resume tokens so billing can fallback, or 2) maintain tiny kvcache dedupe table (session, seq)->charge_id TTL=30s across pools. i prefer kvcache for less protocol churn.
clare: console ask: surface a timeline annotation "route-reassigned" with tooltip "route_reassign -> possible resume replay" and a per-tenant `resume.dupe_rate` chart so oncall can triage quickly.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-9144 to track edge hotfix, kvcache prototype, and console panel. owners: clare(edge), jordan(billing), sam(console).
sam: will add a small alert rule: resume.dupe_rate > 0.2% for 10m -> paging.
clare: thanks. I'll open PR for the 2s dedupe hotfix and attach queries for INF-9144. :thumbsup:
